description: Passes the customer, with a short summary of what they need, to a person on the business’s team, who contacts them on WhatsApp or by phone. For when the customer asks for a person. Only for businesses that take requests through AI assistants; others answer with their WhatsApp and chat links.

business.description: The business id from find_businesses, e.g. "carat-story".

phone.description: The customer’s phone or WhatsApp number with country code, e.g. +91 98765 43210, shared by the customer to be contacted.

summary.description: What the customer needs, in a few sentences.

name: hand_off_to_team
title: Pass the customer to a person
